facts.fact: Capital FM reports Lands Secretary Alice Wahome announced fifteen more counties will join the National Land Information Management System (Ardhisasa) digitisation, costing at least Sh35 billion over five to six years, after a first phase covering Nairobi and Murang'a.

systems.owner: State Department for Lands and Physical Planning

facts.fact: Capital FM reports the national land records digitisation programme, converting physical records to digital form, covered Nairobi and Murang'a in its first phase and will extend to fifteen more counties.
